exactMathematicalLaw: For legal same-rank/same-mover nonterminal q_A, q_B and bijection π of columns satisfying h_A[c]=h_B[π(c)], map all future cells (c,row>=hA[c]) to (π(c),row). If mapped P0 completion upset of qA is included in P0 upset qB, while P1 upset qB is included in mapped P1 upset qA, then unrestricted P0-relative WDL V(qA)<=V(qB) for all remaining moves. Finite-rank induction preserves every future legal move through π and first-win terminal/draw guards. Mutual inclusion under SAME π proves exact future program isomorphism, including all subsequent optimal action-label transports.
partialGeneratorPruning: Partial column mapping assigns source/target height-compatible columns; a source residual generator whose every column has been assigned maps to a fixed future-cell set. If no target generator is contained, that directional upset inclusion can never be satisfied by any extension. Equivalent inverse-mapped target residual constraints and both WDL ordering directions are tracked separately. Pruning occurs only if BOTH directions are impossible; complete permutations remain sufficient exact certificates.
sourceOnlyConstruction: Original source h,R0,R1, exact one-player P1 source cofactor, minimal generator normalization, capacity bijection constraints, fixed column permutations and subset tests. No concrete future-game states or searched policy/value inputs.

rigorousScope: A fixed column transporter matches ALL subsequent legal adaptive P0/P1 replies by one global bijection and guarantees full-game P0 WDL weak order; mutual inclusion under a single map yields exact full-future policy/action isomorphism. This is stronger than bounded reply-mask equivalence. It is a sufficient criterion, not a complete strategic classification.
tieDiscipline: Weak dominance alone cannot drop a P1 reply from the full optimal move LABEL set because it may tie. The equal-isomorphism pairs may be returned as linked tied-value groups; identifying which groups attain the root minimax still requires an exact value certificate.
